title.narrative: Sichuan Climate-Smart Low-Carbon Agriculture Development Demonstration Program

description.narrative: The proposed results-based lending (RBL) program will support sectoral and time slice of the broader government program through three outputs: (i) climate smart agriculture capacity developed, (ii) sustainable and climate resilient agriculture production modernized; and (iii) sustainable low carbon agriculture systems developed in 10 districts/counties.

description.narrative: Low-carbon and climate-resilient agriculture in program areas improved

A pool of certification-based technicians and trainers for gender-inclusive, climate-resilient, and low-carbon agriculture development has been established in Sichuan Province Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

At least 750,000 people (including 375,000 female and 112,500 low-income farmers, small-scale farmers, or older farmers) directly benefited from the program's climate-smart agriculture and enhanced food security Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

One million tons CO2e of cumulative agricultural greenhouse gas emission reduced by the program Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Area coverage ratio of commercialized agriculture service systems in the target counties/districts reaches 13% Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Application coverage ratio of climate-smart agriculture practices in the nine target counties/districts reaches 50% Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Climate-smart and low-carbon agriculture capacity enhanced Indicator: 50,000 participants (including at least 22,500 women and 5,000 low-income farmers, small-scale farmers, and older farmers) participate in technical training and capacity building on low-carbon and climate-smart agriculture; At least 30 out of 90 certified climate-smart agricultural trainers are women. Data Source: Training records; Semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Output: Climate-smart and low-carbon agriculture capacity enhanced Indicator: At least 20 micro, small, and medium-sized agricultural enterprises, cooperatives, family farms, or village economic organizations owned and/or led by women in the program area adopt climate-resilient and low-carbon practices or skills Data Source: Semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Output: Climate-smart and low-carbon agriculture capacity enhanced Indicator: At least three knowledge products on best practices from the program published Data Source: Semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Output: Climate-smart and low-carbon agriculture capacity enhanced Indicator: Integrated climate-smart agriculture monitoring systems developed in the target districts and counties Data Source: Semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Output: Low-carbon agriculture and transformation of agricultural production demonstrated Indicator: 100,000 smart agricultural machinery equipped/replaced for higher energy efficiency and less pollution emission during the program period Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Output: Low-carbon agriculture and transformation of agricultural production demonstrated Indicator: 40% of crop straws recycled and ecologically utilized with carbon emission reduction benefits in the program area Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Output: Low-carbon agriculture and transformation of agricultural production demonstrated Indicator: 42,000 ha of farmlands improved with higher soil quality and carbon stock in the program area during the program period Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:

Output: Low-carbon agriculture and transformation of agricultural production demonstrated Indicator: 500,000 ha of farmlands applied chemical fertilizer reduction measures in the program area Data Source: Government annual statistics, semiannual program progress reports, program completion report Actual value:
